text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Ethereum's 2.8% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 1.6% drop, suggesting slightly weaker conviction in altcoins relative to the largest asset. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 63 (greed territory) but has declined 10 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling from recent highs despite still leaning optimistic. Bitcoin dominance at 58.2% and $66B in daily volume point to a market with moderate participation—neither panic liquidation nor explosive buying pressure.
